news.title: David Payne engineered a business empire. Now, he’s investing in the next generation.
news.summary_en: The Mizzou graduate credits his education with helping him build a successful company. His recent $50 million gift will help position the university as a leader in energy innovation and support student success.

news.title: The secret life of leaves: Mizzou expert explains the science of fall colors
news.summary_en: John Walker reveals how trees change color, reclaim nutrients and prepare for winter.

news.title: More than football: One family’s century-long connection to Mizzou
news.summary_en: What began with four season tickets when Memorial Stadium opened in 1926 has grown into a family tradition spanning generations — and a connection to the university that helped shape their lives.

news.title: The art of success: Mizzou study shows arts education benefits students with disabilities
news.summary_en: New findings show how greater access to arts education can improve attendance, behavior and writing scores for students with disabilities while maintaining achievement in other subjects.

news.title: Mizzou researchers put AI's understanding of people to the test
news.summary_en: The framework helps scientists determine whether AI can identify meaningful patterns in human experiences and shows where human insight makes a difference.

news.title: The gift of gratitude: Why being thankful matters beyond Thanksgiving
news.summary_en: A Mizzou expert shares simple ways to make gratitude a daily habit and explains how it can improve our well-being and help us connect with others.

news.title: KBIA wins National Edward R. Murrow Award for investigative reporting
Meet MUPD Deputy Chief April Colbrecht
news.summary_en: She came to Mizzou to work with animals. Instead, she found a calling in public safety and rose to become MUPD’s deputy chief

news.title: Mizzou veterinary students give shelter animals a fresh start
news.summary_en: Through thousands of surgeries each year, students gain valuable hands-on experience while helping dogs and cats prepare for adoption.

news.title: Mizzou student artists create lasting tribute to Memorial Student Union
news.summary_en: Four University of Missouri students are bringing the building’s history to life through a mural that the Mizzou community will help paint.
